prompt_strategy.value:
Our strategy was noticing prominent or central elements of each respective character presented to us with each image. 

Some characters were named based on everyday objects that they resembled, such as cake or a toilet seat. Other characters that took on more complex shapes and colors were named on the basis of immediate aspects we noticed about them, like a prominent color (ie, red), or the closest possible everyday object that their form resembled (a multicolored creature was named "apple" bc of its rounded form). 

We rarely changed our strategy, as we consistently relied on color and form to determine different nicknames that were short and easy to memorize. There was only one instance in which we changed our strategy, as one object took on a form that could not be described by color or shape. So we named it "happy meal" because it was the everyday object that we thought it resembled the most.
